subject.title: fix(qa): allow restricted Mantis worktree traversal

question: Does the execute-only ACL grant through `/home/runner` preserve the intended isolation boundary for untrusted candidate builds on hosted runners?
rationale: The workflow intentionally changes filesystem permissions for code built as a restricted user; green static checks cannot establish the exact accessible paths or whether the trust boundary remains appropriately narrow.

options.title: Require live isolation proof
options.body: Run the changed workflow and review a redacted restricted-user transcript plus baseline/toolchain integrity checks before merge.

options.title: Accept the scoped ACL design
options.body: Merge based on the execute-only parent traversal design if maintainers explicitly accept its hosted-runner isolation tradeoff.

recommendation.title: Require live isolation proof
recommendation.body: Run the changed workflow and review a redacted restricted-user transcript plus baseline/toolchain integrity checks before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They recently implemented the underlying restricted Mantis workflow and can explain or demonstrate the intended access boundary.
